answers.answer: For a track specifying 6 Heat and 3 Stress, shuffle the player's 12 Speed cards, 3 Starting Upgrade cards, and 3 Stress cards together as the draw deck. Put 6 Heat cards face up on the Engine spot, set the Gear pawn to 1st gear, and draw 7 cards.
answers.evidence: Setup: 'Shuffle your 12 Speed cards, 3 Starting Upgrade cards, and 3 Stress cards together as your draw deck'; 'Place 6 Heat cards face up on the Engine'; 'Set Gear pawn to 1st gear'; 'Draw 7 cards.'

answers.answer: You may stay in your current gear. A shift from 1st to 3rd is a two-position shift and costs 1 Heat, paid immediately during Shift Gears by moving a Heat card from Engine to discard. Heat in hand is not available to pay.
answers.evidence: Shift Gears: 'Stay in your current gear, or shift up or down one position for free. You may instead shift two positions by immediately paying 1 Heat during this step'; Paying Heat says Heat moves from Engine to discard and hand Heat cannot pay.

answers.answer: No. In 3rd gear you must commit 3 cards, played face down; you cannot choose to play only two when you have enough playable cards.
answers.evidence: Play Cards: 'Play cards from hand face down equal to your gear number (… 3rd = 3).'

answers.answer: Steps 1 and 2 are simultaneous for all players, in that order. Wait until everyone finishes both before step 3. Then each player completes steps 3–9 before the next player begins, in order from the frontmost car to the last. If cars are side by side, the car closest to the Race Line is ahead and acts first.
answers.evidence: Simultaneous Phase and Sequential Phase: all players complete steps 1–2 simultaneously; each player completes steps 3–9 before the next; frontmost first; closest to Race Line is ahead for turn order.

answers.answer: Cars do not block passage. If your destination space is full, place your car in the first free spot behind the blocking cars. Prefer the spot closest to the Race Line if it is available.
answers.evidence: Special Rules: 'Cars never block passage, but if your destination space is full, place your car in the first free spot behind the blocking cars.' Reveal & Move says to use the spot closest to the Race Line if available.

answers.answer: Discard the flipped Heat and Starting Upgrade cards immediately as non-Speed cards. The Speed 3 card goes in the Play Area on top of the played Stress and supplies speed 3 for that Stress. The played Stress remains underneath it in the Play Area and both are discarded during Replenish Hand. Resolve all played Stress before Adrenaline.
answers.evidence: Stress Cards: flip until a Speed appears; immediately discard each flipped non-Speed card including Heat and Starting Upgrade; put the found Speed in the Play Area on top of the played Stress; resolve all played Stress before Adrenaline.

answers.answer: In a five-car race, the last two cars to move receive Adrenaline, based on the number of cars that started. Each gets 1 extra Cooldown and may add 1 extra speed. The extra speed may be taken before or after Boost. Unused Adrenaline cannot be saved.
answers.evidence: Adrenaline: 'If the race started with 5 or more cars, the last two cars to move receive these benefits'; benefits are 1 extra Cooldown and 1 extra speed; extra speed may be taken before or after Boost; unused Adrenaline cannot be saved.

answers.answer: Yes. In 2nd gear you have Cooldown 1. During React you may move the Heat card from your hand back to Engine, then immediately spend it to Boost, paying it from Engine to discard. Cooldown and Boost may be activated in any order, and Cooldown may precede Boost when you otherwise lack Engine Heat.
answers.evidence: Actions: 2nd gear provides Cooldown 1; React activates Cooldown and/or Boost in any order; 'You may Cooldown Heat from your hand into your Engine, then immediately spend it to Boost'; Paying Heat allows available Cooldown first.

answers.answer: You may Boost once per turn during React. It costs 1 Heat from Engine to discard; you cannot choose to Boost without Engine Heat, though you may Cooldown first during React. Flip and discard non-Speed cards until a Speed card appears; add that Speed card to the Play Area and move its value. Boost speed counts toward corner checks.
answers.evidence: Boost: 'Once per turn during React, pay 1 Heat from Engine to discard'; flip until a Speed card; move its value; 'Boost increases your total speed for corner checks.'

answers.answer: Slipstream is optional. For the corner crossed during Slipstream, check total speed 6, excluding Slipstream movement; speed 6 against limit 4 requires 2 Heat.
answers.evidence: Slipstream: 'optionally move 2 spaces'; it does not increase speed for corner checks but crossing a Corner Line still requires checking. Check Corner: include Boost and Adrenaline speed but exclude Slipstream movement; pay Heat equal to excess.

answers.answer: Check both corners, in the order crossed. At speed 8, pay 2 Heat for the limit-6 corner and 4 for the limit-4 corner, for 6 Heat total.
answers.evidence: Check Corner: 'Check every Corner Line crossed this turn … in the order crossed. For each corner separately, compare your total speed … and pay Heat equal to the excess.'

answers.answer: The limit-4 corner requires 3 Heat, but only 2 are available, so you spin out there. Move all remaining Engine Heat to discard, then return to the first available space before that corner. Take 2 extra Stress cards directly into your hand (4th gear), and set your gear to 1st.
answers.evidence: Spin Out: if unable to pay enough Heat, move all remaining Engine Heat to discard and move to the first available space before the corner; take 2 Stress in 3rd/4th gear; move Gear pawn to 1st.

answers.answer: You may discard unwanted Speed cards, but not Stress or Heat cards. You may not browse any discard pile, including your own; only the top card of each pile is public knowledge.
answers.evidence: Discard: optionally discard unwanted cards from hand, 'but never Stress or Heat'; nobody may browse any discard pile; only the top card is public knowledge.

answers.answer: Move all Play Area cards to your discard pile, then draw only enough cards to bring your hand back to 7, not seven additional cards.
answers.evidence: Replenish Hand: 'Move all Play Area cards to your discard pile, then draw only enough cards to bring your hand back to 7. Do not draw seven additional cards.'

answers.answer: When the draw deck is empty, shuffle your discard pile into a new draw deck and continue the interrupted flips. Do not include cards still in your Play Area; they have not yet been discarded.
answers.evidence: Running Out of Cards: shuffle discard into a new draw deck, then continue interrupted draws or flips; do not include cards still in Play Area.

answers.answer: When paying Heat, move it from Engine to discard. It cycles from discard to draw deck to hand, and returns to Engine only via Cooldown. Heat cannot normally be played or voluntarily discarded from hand; the summary notes the forced Cluttered Hand exception.
answers.evidence: Paying Heat; Heat Card Cycle: 'Heat moves from Engine to discard to draw deck to hand; only returns to Engine via Cooldown'; Heat cannot normally be played or voluntarily discarded from hand.

answers.answer: Commit both playable cards and fill the remaining two of the four required slots with Heat cards in the Play Area. Your car moves zero spaces. Set your gear to 1st, discard all committed cards including covering Heat, and skip directly to step 9. You skip React, so cannot Cooldown this turn.
answers.evidence: Cluttered Hand: commit playable cards and fill remaining slots with Heat; car moves zero; set gear to 1st, discard all committed cards, skip to step 9, and skip React (so cannot Cooldown or Boost).

answers.answer: Crossing first in the round does not automatically decide it. If multiple cars finish in the same round, the furthest ahead wins, with closest to Race Line breaking ties. At the end of the round remove all cars that crossed the final finish line and place them in finishing order on the Hall of Fame.
answers.evidence: Scoring / Victory Conditions: 'If multiple cars finish in the same round, the car furthest ahead wins (closest to Race Line breaks ties)'; at round end remove finishers and place them in order on Hall of Fame.

answers.answer: On the final lap you cannot Slipstream across the finish line or after crossing it. After crossing that final finish line, ignore speed limits of corners beyond it and move as far as you can.
answers.evidence: Slipstream and Scoring: on final lap, cannot Slipstream across the finish line or after crossing it; after crossing final finish line, ignore speed limits of corners beyond it.

answers.answer: Both remaining cars receive Adrenaline if they are the last two cars to move. Eligibility uses the six cars that started the race, even though four have finished; 5 or more starting cars means the last two movers qualify.
answers.evidence: Adrenaline: if race started with 5 or more cars, last two to move receive benefits; use starting car count even after finishers leave the track.

answers.answer: The selected board specifies the required lap count. USA normally uses 2 laps, and the suggested first-game learning race may be shortened to 1 lap.
answers.evidence: Setup: 'Use the number of laps printed on the selected board'; 'For a first USA learning race, you may race just 1 lap instead of its normal 2.'

answers.answer: The board determines how many Heat and Stress cards each player adds; 6 Heat and 3 Stress are typical, not universal.
answers.evidence: Setup: 'Check the board for how many Heat and Stress cards each player adds (typically 6 Heat and 3 Stress).'

answers.answer: The cars are randomly placed on the starting grid in ascending order. Round turn order is frontmost car first, with the car closest to the Race Line ahead when side by side. The summary does not explain the details of the ascending-order assignment, but random placement does not support choosing preferred positions.
answers.evidence: Setup: 'Randomly place all cars on the starting grid in ascending order'; Sequential Phase: turns go frontmost to last, with closest to Race Line ahead.

answers.answer: Place the remaining Stress cards face up near the board as a reserve.
answers.evidence: Setup: 'Place the remaining Stress cards face up near the board as a reserve.'

answers.answer: The optional setup handicap for an experienced driver racing beginners, including whether it adds or removes Heat and for which car, is unsupported by the supplied summary.
answers.evidence: The Setup section describes standard components and setup but does not mention an experienced-player handicap.

answers.answer: No. The largest shift is two positions, and it costs 1 Heat; a shift from 1st to 4th is three positions.
answers.evidence: Shift Gears allows one position for free or two positions by immediately paying 1 Heat; Player Reference gives examples such as 1st to 3rd.

answers.answer: No. The two-position shift cost must be paid immediately during Shift Gears from Engine to discard. Heat in hand cannot pay, and later React Cooldown cannot pay retroactively for that shift.
answers.evidence: Shift Gears: pay 1 Heat immediately during this step; Paying Heat: Engine to discard and hand Heat cannot pay.

answers.answer: Resolve each played Stress card by flipping until a Speed card appears; each Stress card has its own resolution. The total is 2 + 3 + 4 = 9. The found Speed cards supply the Stress cards' speed and are placed on top of those Stress cards in the Play Area; they are not additional cards committed from hand.
answers.evidence: Stress Cards: 'For each Stress card you played, flip cards from your draw deck until a Speed card appears'; found Speed supplies that Stress's speed and goes on top of it in Play Area. Play Cards sets the hand commitment by gear number.

answers.answer: The summary does not say whether you may voluntarily move fewer spaces than your total speed to avoid a corner. It says to move forward the sum of the played card values, so voluntary stopping short is unsupported.
answers.evidence: Reveal & Move says to sum values and 'move your car forward that many spaces'; no voluntary short-move option is stated.

answers.answer: Use total speed 8 for the corner check, not the 5 spaces moved. The limit-6 corner therefore requires 2 Heat.
answers.evidence: Check Corner: compare 'your total speed for the round' with the corner Speed Limit; destination fullness affects placement, not the stated corner-check speed.

answers.answer: No. A corner is checked only if you crossed its Corner Line; being near it without crossing does not require payment.
answers.evidence: Check Corner: 'Check every Corner Line crossed this turn'; the step applies if a Corner Line was crossed.

answers.answer: At speed 6 or below, the limit-6 corner requires no Heat, so an empty Engine alone does not cause a spin out. Heat is paid only for speed above the limit.
answers.evidence: Check Corner: 'If your speed does not exceed a corner's limit, pay nothing'; Spin Out applies when you cannot pay required Heat.

answers.answer: You can pay exactly 3 Heat and continue. The summary says to pay the excess for each corner and spin out only if you cannot pay enough; it does not require Heat to remain in Engine afterward.
answers.evidence: Check Corner: pay Heat equal to the excess; Spin Out: 'If you cannot pay enough Heat for a corner' you spin out.

answers.answer: At the limit-6 corner, speed 8 requires 2 Heat, leaving 3. At the following limit-4 corner, it requires 4, so that second corner causes the spin out. Move the remaining 3 Engine Heat to discard and return to the first available space before the second corner. Take 2 extra Stress cards into hand for 4th gear, then set gear to 1st.
answers.evidence: Check Corner: check every corner separately in order and use the same total speed; Spin Out: move all remaining Engine Heat to discard, return before the corner that caused spin out, take 2 Stress in 3rd/4th gear, and set gear to 1st.

answers.answer: Take 1 extra Stress card directly into your hand and end in 1st gear.
answers.evidence: Spin Out: take 1 extra Stress in 1st/2nd gear, directly into hand; move Gear pawn to 1st.

answers.answer: 1st gear provides Cooldown 3. With Adrenaline's extra Cooldown 1, you have up to 4 Cooldown. You are not required to cool all five Heat cards; the summary describes Cooldown as something you may activate.
answers.evidence: Player Reference: 1st gear Cooldown 3; Adrenaline gives 1 extra Cooldown; Actions: 'You may Cooldown Heat cards from your hand back to your Engine.'

answers.answer: Yes. Adrenaline's extra speed may be added, while its extra Cooldown is a separate benefit; the summary does not require taking the extra speed to use Cooldown.
answers.evidence: Adrenaline grants access to 1 extra Cooldown and says the player 'may add 1 extra speed'; React activates available Cooldown and/or Boost.

answers.answer: Yes. Adrenaline eligibility follows turn position: the last car to move qualifies. In a four-car race, only that car gets Adrenaline; the second-to-last car does not qualify because the two-car rule applies only when the race started with 5 or more cars.
answers.evidence: Adrenaline: last car to move receives it; if race started with 5 or more cars, last two cars receive it.

answers.answer: You qualify if you end next to another car or in the space immediately behind a car. If neither condition holds, you do not qualify.
answers.evidence: Slipstream: 'If you end next to another car or in the space immediately behind a car, optionally move 2 spaces forward.'

answers.answer: Yes, based on the summary's order: Boost happens during React, before Slipstream, and Slipstream eligibility is checked at the Slipstream step. If the Boost leaves you immediately behind a car then, you meet the stated condition.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure orders React before Slipstream; Slipstream condition is phrased as 'If you end next to another car or in the space immediately behind a car.'

answers.answer: Just one optional two-space Slipstream move; qualifying by multiple cars does not provide multiple moves.
answers.evidence: Slipstream says if you end next to another car or immediately behind a car, optionally move 2 spaces forward (one action).

answers.answer: Slipstream does not allow sharing an occupied spot. If its destination space is full, place your car in the first free spot behind the blocking cars. The Slipstream movement does not increase speed for the corner check.
answers.evidence: Blocked Movement: if destination is full, use first free spot behind blocking cars. Slipstream: movement does not increase speed for corner checks.

answers.answer: Crossing the final finish line does not waive the check for the limit-4 corner crossed before it: at speed 8, that corner costs 4 Heat. Ignore speed limits for the limit-3 corner beyond the final finish line, so total Heat due is 4.
answers.evidence: Check Corner says check every crossed Corner Line; Scoring says after crossing the final finish line, ignore speed limits of corners beyond it.

answers.answer: The summary states a restriction only for the final lap, so it supports Slipstream across a start/finish line on a non-final lap. It also says to check every Corner Line crossed and only exempts corners beyond the final finish line, so corners beyond a non-final lap's line retain their normal limits.
answers.evidence: Slipstream prohibits crossing the finish line on the final lap; Check Corner checks every Corner Line crossed; the beyond-finish exception is specifically after crossing the final finish line.

answers.answer: The remaining cars continue racing; play continues until all cars finish. Finished cars are removed at the end of the round in which they crossed the final finish line.
answers.evidence: Scoring: 'Continue playing until all cars finish'; at end of round remove cars that crossed final finish line and place them in finishing order.

answers.answer: The summary does not mention Legends Lines or explain their use. The core-game effect of crossing one is unsupported.
answers.evidence: The supplied summary's corner rules refer to Corner Lines; no Legends Line appears in its sections.

answers.answer: No. Shift Gears comes before Play Cards and determines how many cards you must play. If you shift from 3rd to 2nd, you must commit 2 cards; your two playable cards meet that requirement, so Cluttered Hand is not triggered.
answers.evidence: Steps 1–2 are Shift Gears then Play Cards; Play Cards requires cards equal to gear number. Cluttered Hand applies if Heat leaves too few playable cards for your gear.
